covers.prediction: The Wuhan virus could become a pandemic
covers.what_happened: The WHO declared the COVID-19 pandemic weeks later.

covers.prediction: The crisis would make government much bigger, and some power would stay
covers.what_happened: States spent trillions and controlled daily life, then gave up most controls.

covers.prediction: Economies would run at about 90 percent of normal for a long time
covers.what_happened: It fitted 2020 and 2021, but vaccines and spending brought a stronger bounce.

covers.cover: The next catastrophe (and how to survive it)
covers.prediction: The world should prepare properly for the next big disaster
covers.what_happened: More shocks came, and experts still say preparedness is weak.
